question: How does abstaining from food by day lead to overcoming death from aging?
premises: Death from aging is the object
inference: By abstaining from food by day, one will overcome death from aging.
uncertainties: the exact sense of gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ is contextually interpreted as overcoming or passing beyond
plain_english: By abstaining from food by day, one will overcome death from aging.
